ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large white contiguous regions occupy the lateral 2/3 of both lobes. A high-density black region spans the midline and extends along the trailing edges. Discrete black focal spots are visible within the white fields, particularly concentrated on the interior of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetrical V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 55 degrees and a depth approximately 1/5th of the visible vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations visible along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased pixel amplitude (5-15 pixels) near the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge trajectory tapering to acute distal tips; trailing edge exhibits a slight sigmoid curve from the notch to the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dozens of localized, roughly circular high-intensity (white) pixel clusters distributed across the central dark region and along the trailing edge margins of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three prominent, near-parallel dark vertical linear markings on the medial portion of the left fluke lobe; additional horizontal rake marks visible on the central dark region near the notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular, jagged topography at the distal tips with associated high-intensity pixel clusters indicative of prior barnacle colonization; prominent dark vertical scarring on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique pattern of discrete black focal spots within the white pigmentation field of the inner right lobe.
